title: AI liquid-cooling systems
plain: Powerful computer racks produce more heat than ordinary fans can remove. This factory makes tested fluid assemblies that carry coolant safely between cooling equipment and the racks.
analogy: A carefully controlled radiator network for computers, with each joint and branch checked before delivery.
product: OEM-approved stainless-steel rack manifolds, hose/tube assemblies and pump/filter fluid modules, supplied with inspection records.
does: Distributes coolant evenly, keeps the loop clean and allows an integrator to install a repeatable assembly.
customers: Cooling-system OEMs
AI server and rack integrators
Approved data-centre mechanical contractors
Industrial power-electronics cooling suppliers
whyNow: Schneider launched a Motivair liquid-cooling factory in Bengaluru in February 2026. OCP is developing shared cooling interfaces and requirements. These establish a real ecosystem, not an order for this factory. [S1] [S2]
firstProduct: One customer-approved family of supply/return rack manifolds and associated pump/filter modules for single-phase water/glycol loops. Select material, interfaces and rated operating conditions with the customer before machine purchase.
notIncluded: No GPU chip manufacture, package-specific microchannel cold plates, proprietary quick-disconnect valves, complete megawatt CDU or semiconductor UHP gas system in the starter scope.
entry: Recruit a fluid-system manufacturing lead and win a paid prototype programme from a cooling OEM. Manufacture tubes, weldments and assemblies; buy approved pumps, couplings, sensors and controls. Outsource passivation and specialist corrosion/thermal qualification initially.
capacity: Planning assumption after qualification: 240 manifold sets and 60 small fluid modules per year, one 8-hour shift over 250 days. Product mix and test time must be measured during pilot builds.

title: Precision parts for semiconductor equipment
plain: Make carefully measured metal parts that fit inside the machines used to manufacture chips. Begin with selected mechanical parts, then earn approval for more demanding assemblies.
analogy: Supply the accurately fitted bones and joints of a machine that makes chips.
product: Customer-drawing aluminium and stainless-steel brackets, mounting plates, supports and selected clean mechanical assemblies, with inspection and material records.
does: Gives equipment makers a qualified Indian source for repeat parts, engineering changes and local service stock.
customers: Semiconductor equipment OEMs and their approved contract manufacturers

entry: Hire an equipment-sector manufacturing lead; secure drawing access, supplier requirements and paid sample work. Machine in-house. Use approved external vendors for anodising, passivation, heat treatment and specialist analytical testing until volumes justify internal investment.
capacity: Planning basis: four CNC machines, one eight-hour shift and 250 working days give 8,000 scheduled machine-hours/year. Budget 4,500–5,500 productive cutting hours after setups and downtime; piece output depends on actual cycle times.

title: AI-facility power distribution
plain: Build the electrical assemblies that divide incoming power safely among equipment circuits. Begin with AC distribution panels for data centres and industrial facilities.
analogy: A carefully protected set of main roads and junctions that routes electricity to the right destination.
product: Engineered low-voltage AC distribution boards with formed copper busbars, approved protection devices, labelled wiring and test documentation.
does: Routes and protects electrical supplies while giving operators clear isolation, monitoring and maintenance points.
customers: Data-centre electrical EPC contractors
Approved switchboard OEMs seeking manufacturing partners
Colocation and enterprise data-centre operators through their consultants
Industrial facilities and semiconductor-factory electrical contractors
whyNow: ABB's announced India manufacturing expansion includes critical infrastructure products. NVIDIA's 800 VDC roadmap shows rising AI power-system demands, but it is a future architecture and a separate qualification problem. The starter sells defined AC distribution assemblies, not an assumed compatible 800 VDC system. [S1] [S2]
firstProduct: Indoor 415 VAC distribution-board families, with an initial assumed 630–2,500 A range under an established, verified assembly design platform. Each contract specifies prospective fault current, enclosure, protection, environment and maintainability.
notIncluded: No utility transformer, UPS power electronics, GPU power shelf, proprietary circuit breaker or complete 800 VDC system. Standalone busway is a separate product scope with its own applicable standard and verification.
entry: Secure an appropriate OEM assembly-system agreement and an experienced panel-design lead. Form and finish approved copper busbars, assemble and wire in-house. Buy approved devices and outsource sheet-metal manufacture, coating, plating and high-power verification initially.
capacity: Planning basis: 120–180 cubicles/year after qualification, one eight-hour shift and 250 working days. A complete distribution board may contain several cubicles; this is not a commitment to 180 complete switchboards.

plain: This factory builds the machines that check a battery pack before it leaves its production line. It sells an engineered test station, its software and ongoing service.
analogy: A factory checkout desk that verifies a battery's identity, electrical health and assembly before dispatch.
product: A modular end-of-line test station with a guarded fixture, electrical instruments, battery communication software, leak-test option and traceable results.

title: Silicon-carbide power module packaging
plain: This factory turns purchased silicon-carbide chips into robust power-switching modules. The module is then fitted inside a charger, inverter or other power converter.
analogy: The chips are the working engines; the module provides their electrical connections, insulation and route for heat to escape.
product: A qualified 1,200 V half-bridge power-module family, with application data, serialised production test results and agreed reliability evidence.
does: Helps converter manufacturers switch electrical power efficiently in a package they can mount, cool and integrate.

title: Ultra-high-purity gas delivery assemblies

analogy: Like a hospital's sterile fluid line, with each joint tracked and checked before use.
product: Customer-approved inert-gas valve manifold panels, small distribution boxes and orbital-welded tube-spool kits, with test records and installation support.
does: Divides and controls nitrogen or argon supply without adding particles, moisture or avoidable leaks; connects the facility distribution system to a tool's approved interface.
customers: Fab or OSAT facilities engineering teams

whyNow: India has operating semiconductor plants and further approved facilities; these require utilities, extensions and maintenance. This is a technology-JV opportunity; Indian policy does not provide customer designs, yield know-how or committed utilisation.
firstProduct: One licensed 300mm fan-in WLCSP family for an anchor analog/PMIC or compatible sensor product, initially one or two copper redistribution layers with customer-approved bump pitch and dielectric stack. Begin with one die family and a frozen process design kit.
notIncluded: No leading-edge GPU die fabrication, HBM stacking, silicon interposer/TSV line, hybrid bonding, fan-out panel packaging or universal OSAT portfolio. A small WLCSP package is not a GPU package. Automotive qualification is a later customer-specific programme.
entry: Form a funded Indian JV with an operating packaging technology owner. Secure transfer of the process, package-design rules, customer test programme and experienced resident team. Obtain binding commercial arrangements for wafer supply, qualification lots, liability and capacity before ordering the production line.
capacity: Planning assumption: initially qualify and load 1,000-2,000 300mm wafer-equivalents/month, progressing towards 3,000-5,000 only after bottleneck validation. Operate three shifts, six days/week; device output varies enormously with die size and yield. This is not a vendor-guaranteed nameplate.

budget.basis: INR crore, 2026 pre-feasibility allowance for a long-term leased/leased-to-spec industrial shell. Advanced cleanroom/process fit-out included; purchased land, new base shell/civil construction and recoverable GST excluded. No subsidy deducted. Equipment and technology configuration could materially change this range.

process.name: Co-design and incoming wafer release
process.plain: Agree the package before receiving production wafers.
process.detail: Use licensed design rules, incoming wafer maps and customer ownership/liability terms.
process.check: Package design review and incoming wafer acceptance.

process.name: Prepare and coat the wafer
process.plain: Apply the agreed protective/insulating layers.
process.detail: Clean wafer and run the licensed dielectric process without exposing it to uncontrolled contamination.
process.check: Film thickness and defect checks.

process.name: Pattern the connections
process.plain: Define where new electrical routes will sit.
process.detail: Expose/develop the agreed pattern aligned to the original device contacts.
process.check: Overlay and patterned-feature acceptance.

process.name: Build the redistribution metal
process.plain: Create the copper pathways and contact foundations.
process.detail: Run qualified deposition/plating/strip sequence; repeat only for the approved layer count.
process.check: Thickness, resistance and defect control.

process.name: Form solder interconnects
process.plain: Add the contacts that connect to a circuit board.
process.detail: Apply the selected bump/ball route and reflow under the licensed recipe.
process.check: Bump geometry and interconnect checks.

process.name: Thin and electrically test
process.plain: Prepare the wafer and identify good devices.
process.detail: Use the qualified handling/grinding sequence and customer test programme; exact ordering follows the process flow.
process.check: Wafer map, electrical yield and thickness accepted.

process.name: Singulate and pack
process.plain: Separate good devices and protect them for shipment.
process.detail: Dice, inspect and sort according to wafer map; pack with orientation and lot identity.
process.check: Chipping, visual and traceability acceptance.

process.name: Release and monitor reliability
process.plain: Confirm the process remains suitable over time.
process.detail: Execute customer qualification/monitoring plan and investigate excursions before releasing affected lots.
process.check: Customer qualification and controlled lot disposition.
